## Appearance

Annetta Bell is a pale child with fine, silky, fawn-colored hair. Her smooth hair falls in ripples that flow over her shoulders.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006)_

## History

Annetta Bell lived in the [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge) school district until her parents moved their house fifty yards north to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). As a student at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school under [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), she wrote a composition about her home life that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shared in a letter to a friend. Later, she was among the students left sorrowful when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resigned from her teaching position.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), +3 more_
